cv.name: Simran Pannu
cv.headline: Senior Civil Engineer, P.Eng., PMP | Municipal Infrastructure
cv.summary: Civil engineer with eleven years in municipal water, roads and transit projects in the Lower Mainland. Designs and stamps drawings but has spent the last four years mostly managing projects end to end, from budget to construction.

experience.title: Senior Civil Engineer / Project Manager
bullets: Project manager for watermain and sewer renewal contracts worth $4–22M for three municipalities
Engineer of record for detailed design packages; review and seal drawings
Manage budgets, schedules and change orders; delivered 2024 program 6% under budget
Lead a team of five EITs and technologists
Present to councils and run public open houses

experience.title: Civil Engineer (EIT, then P.Eng.)
bullets: Road and intersection design in Civil 3D for transit priority corridors
Prepared tender documents to MMCD standards

experience.title: Junior Engineer
bullets: Utility inspections and as-built reviews for development projects

skills: Budgets, schedules and change orders (MS Project)
